Turn one says her 19 Oct request in words the prompt never uses (her own words are in the prompt as the routing example, and an exam question in the prompt is an answer key); turn two says the same thing in other words ('a lighter lunch and a heavier dinner'), so a coach keying on 'move' or 'calories' cannot pass by accident; turn three is the tapped amount, which must reach the same tool with kcal, not a refit and not a whole-meal move. The nearest neighbours cost different things: propose_meal_move moves a WHOLE meal into another slot, propose_meal_refit resizes every meal onto the targets.
